title: Consolidate CommandCenterUI loopback constants behind one config point
description: Implements the near-term action of DEC-029. EXTERNAL EDIT — carries all six elements the CommandCenterUI boundary gate requires. (1) EXPLICIT OPERATOR APPROVAL NAMING THE EXTERNAL PATH, given directly by bigboss in session on 2026-07-23, verbatim: 'Approved: claude-lab-zaro may edit /home/mellow/Projects/CommandCenterUI/app/server.py to consolidate the three loopback constants behind one config point. No behaviour change, no remote support, no new controls.' (2) OUTPUT PATH: /home/mellow/Projects/CommandCenterUI/app/server.py and only that file, plus a delivery note inside the canonical MAP repo for evidence. (3) OUTSIDE-SCOPE NOTE: this is outside the canonical MAP repo's normal writable scope; CommandCenterUI is a separate codebase with its own runtime and restart lifecycle. (4) VALIDATION PLAN: restart via ~/Projects/CommandCenterUI/run-command-center-app.sh --server-only (backend) or without the flag for the GTK/WebKit window, port from COMMAND_CENTER_UI_PORT default 8765; verify the server starts cleanly, local model discovery still lists models, a launched local helper still targets loopback, and setting OLLAMA_HOST in the environment before start does NOT redirect anything. (5) READ-ONLY VS WRITE-CAPABLE: neither — this is an internal refactor of an existing surface, adding no controls and no endpoints, so the write-control spec requirement does not apply. (6) N/A — not write-capable control work. WHY NOW: DEC-029 permits a remote OLLAMA_HOST only as explicit, UI-visible configuration and keeps ambient env inheritance forbidden. Three hardcoded sites make the eventual second-machine change expensive and likely to be done in a hurry by someone who reverts the hardening to make it work. Consolidating now is a no-behaviour-change refactor that makes that future change small and reviewable. SCOPE DISCIPLINE: exactly three call sites plus one new configuration constant. If the refactor wants to touch more, STOP and report rather than widen — this is a running operator surface in an external repo.
acceptance_criteria: All three loopback sites resolve from a single configuration point defaulting to 127.0.0.1:11434: OLLAMA_URL (was line 100) and the two env['OLLAMA_HOST'] assignments (were lines 424 and 846). Line numbers verified at edit time, not taken from the description.

The configuration point does NOT read an ambient OLLAMA_HOST. Proven by running the app with OLLAMA_HOST set to a different value and showing behaviour is unchanged and no traffic is redirected — this is the property DEC-029 rests on and the one most likely to be broken by a well-meaning refactor.
No behaviour change: the server starts cleanly, local model discovery still lists models, and a launched local helper still targets loopback, evidenced by an actual restart rather than assertion.
No remote support, no new endpoints, no new controls, and no changes outside the constant consolidation. Diff is limited to server.py and touches only the three sites plus the added constant.
DEC-029 is referenced in the code comment as the reason the consolidation exists, so a future reader finds the policy rather than guessing at intent.
Evidence recorded via the TASK-219 delivery-note template and routed to an independent reviewer who is neither claude-lab-zaro nor claude-lab-bima.
